lines.say: DNA stores hereditary information in the order of its bases: A, T, C and G.
A gene is a section of DNA that codes for a product, usually a protein.
Each gene sits at a fixed position on a chromosome, called its locus.
An allele is a different version of a gene, like an acoustic version of a track.
A chromosome is one long DNA molecule wrapped around histone proteins.
Before division, it's copied. Two sister chromatids join at the centromere.

draw.alt: A single chromosome copied into two sister chromatids joined at the centromere

lines.say: Count the centromeres. One centromere is still one chromosome.
Chromosomes come in pairs. One from mum, one from dad.
Same size, same centromere position, same genes at the same loci.

draw.alt: Homologous chromosomes 9 from mum and dad; ABO gene highlighted with A and O alleles

lines.say: But they may carry different alleles. So they're not identical.
Sister chromatids are the identical copies. Two photocopies, not two editions.
Humans have 46 chromosomes: 22 pairs of autosomes, plus one pair of sex chromosomes.
The Y is small, with few genes. SRY triggers testes.
Body cells are diploid, 2n equals 46. Gametes are haploid, n equals 23.
At fertilisation, 23 plus 23 makes 46 again.

draw.alt: Sperm with 23 and egg with 23 join into a zygote with 46

lines.say: Every egg carries an X. The sperm carries X or Y, so it decides sex.
A karyotype displays all of one cell's chromosomes in pairs.
Cells are stopped in metaphase, when chromosomes are most condensed.
Pair them by size, centromere position and banding. Some Cats Bark.
Autosomes go 1 to 22, sex chromosomes last. A typical male is 46, XY.
A karyotype can't show single-gene changes, like cystic fibrosis.
Aneuploidy means a chromosome too many or too few.
It usually comes from non-disjunction, when chromosomes fail to separate in meiosis.
Trisomy means three copies. Down syndrome has three chromosome 21s.

draw.alt: Chromosome 21 shown as a pair, then a third copy added

lines.say: Monosomy means one copy. Turner syndrome is 45, X.
Klinefelter syndrome is 47, XXY. Write the total, the sex chromosomes, then the change.
Polyploidy is whole extra sets, like seedless triploid watermelons.
After DNA copying, a human cell still has 46 chromosomes, not 92.
A gamete has 23 single chromosomes, not 23 pairs.
Say homologous chromosomes or sister chromatids, never just pairs.
Tri means three, mono means one.
